Introduction

Background
PNB is the market leader for unit trust business in Malaysia. PNB’s objective is to provide excellent unit trust services, innovative solutions for their customers and agents as well.
Organization of the Document
The first chapter of this document gives an introduction with brief background and organization of the document.  Subsequent chapters cover the details of the actual enhancements.
Acronyms and Abbreviations

Requirements Summary
The enhancements scoped in the document are relating to Improvement (for Data Patch) meeting dated 15th August 2023 that was held in response to the CASD and OFSS receiving repeated requests and pending user service request for OFSS to proceed with detail assessment and development.
Change cheque status
Requirements Overview
The existing ‘Cheque Status Summary’ (UTDCHKST) screen to be enhanced by enabling operation ‘Mark Status Change’ for following cheque’s status for HQ and FMG Module :

Active
Stop
Cleared
Rejected
Expired

Unclaimed
Duplicate
Currently the operation ‘Mark Status Change’ is allowed only for cheque with status ‘Active’.
This will allow appointed users to mark the cheque status as below
This changes would not cover for any status sent by SAP for second time

Existing Functionality
Currently system allow to Mark Status change for Cheque in UTDCHKST screen only for Cheque Status Active.
Cheques with Cheque Status ‘Active’ is allowed to change only with three Cheque Status which are Rejected, Cleared and Stop on UTDCHKST screen.
Assumptions
Existing functionality to allow change of Cheque Status from ‘Active’ to  Rejected, Cleared and Stop on UTDCHKST screen will be remained as per existing functionality.

Functional Approach
Maintenance
A new field ‘Remarks’ will be introduced in Cheque Status summary screen.
It will be optional field and it will get enable when user select Operation as ‘Mark Status Change’.
Existing field ‘Mark Status change’ will be enhanced to show following values in addition to the existing values:

Active
Duplicate
Expired
Unclaimed
Screen Changes

NA
Processing Changes
Currently system validates that operation ‘Mark Status change’ is applicable only for Current cheque status ‘Active’, if user selected other than ‘Active’ and click on Search button, system displays error message as ‘Cheque Status should be Active when Operation is Mark Status’.
The above validation will be relaxed only from HQ and FMG module if user is selecting Cheque status as Cleared, Expired, Rejected, Unclaimed and Duplicate in addition to current value ‘Active’.
The above validation error message will be modified and show as ‘Cheque Status should be Active, Cleared, Expired, Rejected, Unclaimed and Duplicate when Operation is Mark Status’.

If current Cheque status is ‘Cleared’ then system will allow to change following Cheque statuses:
If user selects other than the above combination, then on click of ‘Mark Status Change’ button, system will display error message as ‘Status Change is not allowed for the selected Cheque Status and Mark Status’.
When Cheque status is changed from Cleared to Duplicate, System will update the existing Cheque status  as ‘Duplicate’ and system will not allow the user to re-issue this cheque.
If current Cheque status is ‘Rejected’, then system will allow to change following Cheque status:
If user selects other than the above combination, then on click of ‘Mark Status Change’ button, system will display error message as ‘Status Change is not allowed for the selected Cheque Status and Mark Status’.

If current Cheque status is ‘Expired, then system will allow to change following Cheque status:
If user selects other than the above combination, then on click of ‘Mark Status Change’ button, system will display error message as Status Change is not allowed for the selected Cheque Status and Mark Status’.
When Cheque status is changed from Expired to Duplicate, System will update the existing Cheque status  as ‘Duplicate’ and system will not allow the user to re-issue this cheque.
If current Cheque status is ‘Unclaimed, then system will allow to change following Cheque status:
If user selects other than the above combination, then on click of ‘Mark Status Change’ button, system will display error message as ‘Status Change is not allowed for the selected Cheque Status and Mark Status’.

When Cheque status is changed from Unclaimed to Duplicate, System will update the existing Cheque status  as ‘Duplicate’ and system will not allow the user to re-issue this cheque.
If current Cheque status is ‘Duplicate, then system will allow to change following Cheque status:
If user selects other than the above combination, then on click of ‘Mark Status Change’ button, system will display error message as ‘Status Change is not allowed for the selected Cheque Status and Mark Status’.
The above cheque status change is allowed only for Cheque status duplicate which is done as part of exceptional cheque status change.
If re-issue cheque existing for the transaction then the above Status change from Duplicate to Expired/ Unclaimed is not allowed.

While marking the cheque status change user can also fill the remarks.
All above exception Cheque status change records will be available to view in Cheque status summary screen UTDCHKST with operation ‘View All Records’
The above all exception Cheque status change will be allowed only from ASNBHQ001 and FMGPNB Modules.

Bulk Data Update Patching
Requirements Overview

Bulk Upload data patching for the Financial and Non-Financial transaction will applies certain validation rules. Thus, the proposed approach shall have a field of rules where business user can add and request from the system to validate certain condition (refer below example)
Bulk upload will be done based on excel files or text files prepared by business user.
Any failed transaction during bulk upload, system will also provide the exceptional list/report with details for further action by user.
Below are the example of condition/rules to apply during bulk data patch that requires system validation stated in current SR submission. CASD & OFSS to clarifies on how business users can include some validation when perform bulk uploads.
Update only for Normal status UH

Data Patch document is List of UH with UHID & Financial/Non Financial items to be updated in excel format.
Bulk update on Race/Religion
To update the race and religion field as per list provided (as per info from JPN).
If race and religion field is not blank during data patch, override the race/religion as per list provided(as per info from JPN). We take the race/religion from JPN as absolute info.
OFSS will also come out with the exceptional list of failed cases due to other reasons (ie; abnormal CIF status of Deceased, Closed).

Data extraction is as of 31 May 2023, and therefore expect some information change when comparing with latest record.
If there is a conflict of fund holding possession ie; Bumiputera fund for the Non-Bumi races, OFSS shall tag all the related Bumiputera fund (at fund level) as “MINORITY YES”. This is to allow the update of race and religion to proceed.
OFSS will update the race and religion base on current matrix mapping.
Bulk update on Zipcode & City
To update the zipcode and city field as per list provided, for both Mailing and Residential address in FDS.

To follow current validation in FDS for mailing address does not exist in Postcode mapping in DB.
If zipcode is not blank during data patches(UH could probably have updated their address, Do Not update the zipcode. To exclude and come out with failed cases file/exceptional list.
Failed cases due to other reason, for example change of CIF status i.e Deceased, Closed also require exceptional list for our further action. Failed scenario also on the invalid postcode that does not match with DB, for example character less than 5.
Data extraction is as of 30 June 2023, and should expect some info change update by UH before data patches.
OFSS to identify any CIF update between 1 July 2023 until date of data patches, especially for incorrect zipcode and city. There could be UH has updated his/her new address and overlook on this may resulted to we re-update it as previous zipcode and city identified in the list. Kindly provide an exceptional list for our validation.

Processing Changes
CIF Data Correction
User will be allowed to perform CIF data correction using import interface ‘CIF Data Correction import’.
System will allow user to perform CIF data correction for following Data types or fields for the given unit holder:
Once the file is uploaded successful, system will update the those values in Unit holder FT screen UTDUHFT based on the selected Data types (Fields) only if the Unit hold status is Normal otherwise system will reject it.

Once the file is uploaded successful, system will update ‘Input by’ and ‘Authorized by’ as ‘SYSTEM’ and ‘DateTime’ will be same as File uploaded time, system will also track in Audit trail.
If user has provided wrong codes in upload file for these fields Race, Religion, State and Country which are not available in FCIS system, then FCIS will reject those specific records and log appropriate error message and proceed with other valid records.
System will check the field ‘Existing Value’ given in CIF Data correction import file, if the value is matching with existing field in FCIS, then system will override with value given in field ‘New Value’ in CIF Data correction import file, otherwise system will reject it with error message ‘Mismatching existing value with FCIS’.
If user is trying to update the multiple values for different Data types for a particular UH, if the validation is failed for any data type then system will reject all records for that UH.
For that rejected record due to validation, system will show appropriate error message as per that validation, for other records which were rejected because of this record for same UH, system display error message as “Failed Due to other Records”.

If Unit holder’s category is changed from Bumi to Non-Bumi and Minority flag at UH level is No due to change in Race/Religion, then system will update this UH and Fund combination in UH Fund Minority flag as Yes so his units in Bumi fund or Bumi bucket will remain in that.
If Unit holder’s category is remain as Non-Bumi but Minority flag at UH level is changed from Yes to No, then system will update as Yes for this UH and Fund in UH Fund Minority flag so his units in Bumi fund or Bumi bucket will remain in that.
Refer the acceptable and rejected scenarios of Race and Religion update:
CIF Data correction Status Export
CIF Data Correction Status export will extract all records success or failed  records which were uploaded as part of CIF Data Correction import interface.

Success records will not have errors.
Failed records will have error description.
PNB Transaction Upload
New Interface ‘PNB Transaction Upload’ will be used to create UT Subscription Transactions with payment mode ‘Cash’.
This interface upload will allow transactions in Fixed price funds, Historical VP funds and Forward price Funds.

Once the upload is successful, system will create authorized transactions for successful records.
It will check that given unit holder in upload file is having UH Status as Normal otherwise it will reject that record.
During the upload system will perform all existing validations such as:
Eligible Funds (Bumi/Non-Bumi)
Transactions limits

FHL limits
OMNIS and AMLA Sanctions for the given UH
If any of the validations failed, system will reject that particular record and proceed with other records.
All Mandatory fields are available, if any of the mandatory fields are missing, system will reject that record and log the error.
System will apply Fund Rule Transaction cut off time on this transaction upload.

UT Subscription transactions created through this upload for UH with Risk profile ‘HI’ or ‘MI’ will not undergo SM approval.
If the transaction is failed to generate due to any validation for the given Fund then system will follow priority Fund list to get the next fund, if all validations are passed in that fund then system will create subscription in that fund.
If GenerateBlock’ is uploaded as Yes, then system will first create and allocate the subscription and then it will block transaction with same units.
For Fixed and Historical VP funds, system will allocate the subscription transaction during the PNB Transaction upload, at same time, system will create Block transaction and allocate it.
For Forward price funds, system will allocate the subscription transaction based in allocation lag during EOD, once the Subscription transaction is allotted, at same time will create Block transaction with transaction date same Subscription transaction date and allocate on same day in the Block allocation batch.

The block transaction will have Reason for Block as “Others”.
This block transaction reference number will be same as underlying subscription transaction reference number.
Branch code will be same as uploaded in the PNB Transaction upload file, Input By and Authorized By with be ‘System’.
PNB Transaction upload Status
PNB Transaction upload Status export will extract all records success or failed  which were uploaded as part of PNB Transaction upload import interface.

Success records will have Subscription Transaction Number.
Failed records will have error description.

Processing Changes

To update the HA/TD flag, user has to open the new main screen ‘Update HA/TD Flag’ and click on ‘New’ button and fecth the record.
User has to select Unit holder ID and Fund ID in search criteria, on click of Fetch button system will display only that selected fund if the Unit holder is having holdings or not in that Fund in Result or Body sections.
If the Unit holder and Fund combination, the HA/TD flag is No, then system will not display any records.
Once the system displays records in Body section, then user can tick the check box HA/TD Not Applicable.
If the Unit holder is having any Hibah Block units in that Fund, then on click of save button, system will display warning message as ‘Active Hibah block units will be Un-Blocked. Do you want to continue?' with option as Accept or Cancel, if user click on ‘Cancel’, system will not save it, if user clicks on ‘Accept’ then system will save the record.

once the record is saved, it will be un-authorized status.
Checker will have to query this record either from Main screen to Summary screen and authorized it.
Once the record is authorized successful, system will set HA/TD flag as No even though if the underlying un-block transaction is not allotted.
User can also view the updated values in existing screen Investor Fund balance UTDFNBAL.
Once the record is authorized successful, if there is any Hibah block units exist, then system will perform un-block transaction on Hibah block units.

If the fund is fixed and historical VP funds then system will allocate it immediately, for forward price funds, it will be allotted as per allocation lag and price availability.
This un-block transaction can be view from consolidated Enquiry scree.
System will show the remarks under field Remarks as ‘UNBLOCK DUE TO HA/TD FLAG CHANGE’ in this un-block transaction screen UTDTXL07.
This un-block transaction will be created with Input and authorized by ‘SYSTEM’.

Change UH Account Status
Requirements Overview
Change from Deceased to Normal – due to wrong tagging
Change from Pending Closed to Closed – to solve issue with Income Distribution activity where UH with ineligibility case & not entitle for the dividend.
Unmerge – Change from Closed to Normal – to rectify the wrong merging transaction and to enable business user do the data capture adjustment.

Currently system is not allowing RPO Code change from Deceased to Normal if Deceased tagging was done previous business day
Current validation to restrict Deceased to Normal change should be removed only for ASNBHQ001 and only for specific Users.
A new role can be created and mapped to Users who are allowed to change UH Status from Deceased no Normal.
For this backdated Deceased tagging removal, Cash Till update should be skipped.
If Khairat is already claimed, Khairat payment and Khairat Non fin load should be reversed, and GL should be generated for this reversal.

If Transmission/Hibah claim has already been processed, this change should not be allowed
Other scenario (type of Account Status) also need to cater for the UH Account Status Change, and not only for the Deceased to Normal

Requirements Overview

When BSD/CASD/Portal team require information on changes made to a Unitholder's details, whether due to unitholder complaints or suspected false updates, there is currently no other way to obtain a history of changes except by emailing the OFSS team and requesting the information.
Mobile number duplicate
In the event that a Unitholder attempts to update their mobile number associated with their account and receives a rejection message stating that the mobile number already exists, the Users/Portal team should investigate which other Unitholders have the same mobile number linked to their account.

Email duplicate
In the event that a Unitholder attempts to update their email associated with their account and receives a rejection message stating that the email already exists, the Users/Portal team should investigate which other Unitholders have the same email linked to their account.
